{{Quote|Here you go Hardeen, home sweet home.|The trooper to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He was stationed at the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised himself as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and infiltrated the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center to uncover a plot to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] transported the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to speak to [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] criminal [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] in his cell.<ref name="Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' fourth season, titled "[[Deception]]." He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the actor who portrays all of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers in the series.<ref name="Deception" />
